Anika: Quick follow-up on RCA-842 closeout — we have 4 leftover items that need owners + due dates. Copying list from the doc:
1) Rework canary rollback logic (eng-runtime)
2) Add alert for KV cache memory regression (eng-infra)
3) Customer-facing postmortem draft (support + product)
4) Run full replay of incident traffic for perf regression (eng-sre)
Who can own which? prefer owners + ETA by EOD tomorrow. @Tom @Priya @Jorge

Tom: I can take item 1. Plan to have a PR with tests by Wed EOD and add a canary flag. Will post the PR link here once ready. :thumbsup:

Priya: I'll take item 2 but I'm blocked on a kernel bump from infra. If kernel lands this week I can finish by Fri, otherwise target next Tue. Pinging @infra-team for the bump.

Jorge: I'll pick up item 4. Need a 2h capacity window to run the replay and a brief runbook review. Proposed window Tue 09:00-11:00 PT — does that work? :calendar: @eng-sre

Anika: Thanks all. For item 3 (customer postmortem) can @support-jess or @pm-mike own? If not, I can draft an initial customer-ready version by Thursday.

Jess: I can draft the customer-facing postmortem. I'll coordinate with @pm-mike and aim for a first pass by Thu noon.

Tom: quick note on item 1 — I plan to add an integration test that simulates the canary rollback and a feature flag. PR will include test logs.

Priya: kernel bump PR (blocking me): https://github.com/redwood/kernel/pull/452 — currently pending review. If that merges this week I keep Fri ETA, otherwise I'll update here and move to Tue next week.

Jorge: schedule request confirmed? Tue 09:00-11:00 PT works for me, will add a calendar invite and minimal runbook in this thread.

Anika: Great. I've updated the RCA doc with tentative due dates:
- item1 (canary fix): 2025-03-05
- item2 (KV alert): 2025-03-07 (conditional on kernel bump)
- item3 (customer draft): 2025-03-06
- item4 (replay + analysis): 2025-03-11
We'll do a 48h async check-in (short updates only) — please post status or blockers here. :clock1:

postmortem-bot: Reminder set — follow-up ping scheduled at 48h.
